label: June 10–16, 2026
intro: Big music festival Saturday is the headline — Thor is going to lose his mind.
weekday_note: Nothing major on weekdays this week. Best bet: KidZania Bangkok (open late) or a late-afternoon Lumphini Park scooter session.

activities.title: Bangkok World Music Day 2026
activities.why: 5-stage outdoor music festival with 30+ artists, plus a food market and busking stages. For a kid who loves drums, this is gold — live bands and musicians up close.
activities.tip: Aim for the 2–6pm window — outdoor, cooler(ish), before the adult crowd. Pre-register on the One Bangkok app for free merch.

activities.title: Illust Fusion Expo 2026 (IFEXPO26)
activities.why: 729 independent Thai artists across 1,108 booths — illustrations, handmade crafts, collectibles. All that tactile, handmade art is right up Thor's alley. Let him pick one small piece as a souvenir.
activities.tip: Do this Sunday morning — or combine with World Music Day on Saturday: art in the morning, live music in the afternoon.

activities.title: GDH “Growing Up Together” Orchestra Movie Concert
activities.why: Full orchestra performing 100+ Thai movie songs with top Thai stars. Special — but pricey, and 2+ hours of concert-hall sitting is a tough ask at 5. Best skipped, unless it's a solo treat for dad.

activities.title: Taling Chan Floating Market
activities.why: Right in your backyard! Seafood grills, canal boat rides, traditional musicians. The nearby Artist House in Khlong Bang Luang has a free puppet theater at 2pm on weekends — magical for kids.

activities.title: KidZania Bangkok
activities.why: Thor role-plays as firefighter, pilot, chef, Iron Man's engineer… you get the idea. Perfect when the weather is brutal.

activities.title: Children's Discovery Museum
activities.why: Dino fossil dig, science lab, dress-up corners. Interactive and hands-on — tailor-made for a builder kid.

activities.title: Lumphini Park
activities.why: Big open space to cycle, scooter, or run wild. Monitor lizards as a bonus.
